QF.id: Cat III AIF Due Diligence and Risk_5

question.text: Liquidity Risk for a Cat III AIF refers to:

answer.text: Inability to exit positions at fair value within reasonable time

explanation.text: The Logic: Liquidity risk = inability to exit positions at fair value within reasonable time — especially acute in illiquid Cat III strategies. The Trap: Other concepts are distinct from liquidity risk. Cross-Exam Context: Core AIF risk category. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Stress-test liquidity scenarios (no market bid) as part of ODD.
